# Shruti 1.4.11
This release makes the mixer behave like dependable audio hardware: apps keep their place, 100% means unity, mute means silent, and an untouched app stays on macOS's original direct path.
## Reliable controls
- Moving a volume or boost control no longer repeatedly tears down and reconnects the app's audio graph. Control attachment is retained and gain changes ramp smoothly, avoiding digital glitches and the previous all-loud-or-all-soft feel. - Unity gain is level-matched with true bypass. Shruti adds no compressor, ducking or hidden attenuation unless the user explicitly enables that feature. - Mute is click-free and remains hearing-safe across helper recovery, device switching and license state changes. - The 1x–4x boost uses the same low-latency render path as ordinary volume. Boost does not add a look-ahead stage or an extra buffering cycle.
## Apps that stay where you put them
- **My Order** is entirely user-controlled. Playback starts, stops and meter updates cannot move a row. - **Recent Audio** is the same stable order filtered to apps heard during the last three days; it is not a second auto-sort engine. - A genuinely new playback app is detected once and appended at the bottom. It begins at 100% direct passthrough with no tap and zero added latency until the user changes a control. - Remove and Restore are durable. Capture-only utilities such as Wispr Flow do not reappear due to ambiguous Core Audio process flags. - Search combines known audio applications with apps Shruti has actually heard, so uncommon browsers, instruments and players remain findable after they stop.
## A clearer mixer
- Live output meters show which apps are actually producing sound. - Stable colour tiles, clearer status copy, move-to-top controls and improved spacing make long app lists easier to scan. - The main panel responds to compact and expanded window sizes without clipping app names or controls. - Installed Audio Units can open their native editor window, while Shruti's built-in processors remain available as low-overhead alternatives.
## Device-switch safety
Shruti keeps the 1.4.10 make-before-break guarantee: a replacement route is ready before the old one is released. This release also serializes multi-app handovers on the lifecycle queue, so apps following the default output cannot fight each other during a Mac speaker, display or interface switch.
## Compatibility
Shruti 1.4.11 supports macOS 14.2 or newer and ships universal Apple silicon and Intel binaries. The direct path remains bit-transparent; processing and its honest latency badge appear only for apps the user explicitly controls.
